summaryZh: Kravets实验室研究糖尿病中的胰岛细胞功能网络、钙动态及免疫内分泌相互作用，关注针对产胰岛素β细胞的免疫攻击和网络可塑性。团队结合计算建模、网络分析、多尺度显微成像及图像分割，并使用靶向双光子激光消融、共聚焦显微镜和荧光寿命成像。
researchQuestions: 免疫系统为何开始攻击产胰岛素β细胞？
β细胞功能网络如何在健康及糖尿病中变化？
topics: 糖尿病免疫内分泌相互作用

evidence.quote: Laboratory of Dr. Vira Kravets at UCSD

We apply network theory analysis to Ca2+ traces generated both from computational modeling and from multi-scale quantitative microscopy to understand and predict structural-functional connectivity in the pancreatic islets and disease pathogenesis

Immune-endocrine interactions in pre-diabetes We study to which extent alpha-rich regions are contacted by immune cells due to chance vs due to non-random contact-based interactions. We are using antibody-labeled pancreatic slices from human donors and mice in healthy and diabetic conditions. Network analysis, AI-assisted image segmentation, and MATLAB algorithms are used to reveal dynamic patterns of diabetes development.
Our goal is to understand the pathogenesis of diabetes . Specifically, how and why the immune attack on insulin-producing β-cells begins.
Approaches: Targeted 2-photon laser ablation, Confocal microscopy , Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging, C omputational models, Network (graph) theory, L ive pancreatic tissue with and without diabetes.
